mission.outcome: Land HMS Bellona: implement Zurcher 2014 two-state bread-baking model with radiative outer boundary condition; 3-parameter inverse fit (x_core, j_0, T_oven_eff); test whether main-bake RMSE drops below the M9 Stefan baseline (median 7.5 deg C) when the model has both correct physics class AND correct boundary conditions (radiative not Dirichlet).
